title: VoiceBox AI is a Free, Open-Source AI Voice Generator
description:
Forget ElevenLabs.

There's a free and open-source alternative that lets you clone any voice with just 3 seconds of audio.

The tool is called Voicebox.

You give it a few seconds of any voice, and it copies it perfectly.

Exact tone, exact rhythm, exact natural emotions. Nothing sounds robotic or off.

Think of it like a photocopier for voices.

Feed it a sample, get an identical output every time.

Then you can use that cloned voice to generate speech, stories, or full conversations.

All across 23 languages, without paying a cent for premium tiers.

That's the biggest cost jump most creators hit with ElevenLabs.

Multi-language voice generation usually sits behind a $22 monthly plan.

Voicebox handles it all for free.

And the quality genuinely competes with paid tools.

Plus it rivals WisprFlow for voice-to-text. Just hold a key, speak, and your words land in whatever app you're working in.

Slack, email, Notion, docs, anywhere your cursor sits.

No copy-pasting, no switching windows.

The whole setup runs locally on your machine.

So your voice data never leaves your device, and there's no rate limits or API costs to worry about.

For content creators, podcasters, and anyone building voice-based apps, this changes the entire cost math on voice AI.

#elevenlabs #voicebox #aivoicecloning #voicegenerator #aiaudio
